svg.title: Claude Pet resource use
svg.desc: CPU use of Claude Pet per state, as a percentage of one core: on the laptop 0.80, awake idle 0.48, thinking 0.45, needs you 0.42, working 0.40, asleep with the mouse moving 0.07, asleep 0.00. Memory: 14 MB in every state.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light enough to forget it’s there.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It only redraws when something changes, and sleeps completely when Claude is quiet.
